_huong_dan: Copy file nay thanh 'config.json' roi dien 2 KEY (llm_api_key + youtube_api_key). KHONG chia se config.json.

_ghi_chu.llm_model: Model cho viec chu. Muc suy luan = duoi ten: -high / -medium / -low. VD: ag/gemini-3.8-flash-high.
_ghi_chu.llm_vision_model: Model co 'mat' (nhin anh de rut DNA). De giong llm_model la duoc (Gemini Flash da co vision).
_ghi_chu.youtube_api_key: Lay tai https://console.cloud.google.com -> bat 'YouTube Data API v3' -> tao API key.
